description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage.
When Glen Elendra Archmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Glen Elendra Archmage.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
